wiki_article:
**Fractal Navigation Map v5.0: The Crimson Hexagon Semantic Architecture** is a navigation map by Lee Sharks, deposited 21 January 2026 at 53,927 characters.

It opens with the archive's standing versioning rule: *"This document supersedes v4.0, v4.1, and v4.2 **while preserving all prior versions as active historical layers. No prior version is invalidated.**"*

**Active historical layer** is a precise designation — not deprecated, not archived, but still live as the state of the architecture at its date. That is what allows a citation made against v4.1 to remain resolvable after v5.0 exists, and it is the same principle the Septad Specifications invoke via Article VIII §7 (#1233). The fractal map family is one of the §11 adjudication items, three of its states standing in a version relation that has not been ruled.
